Zoom-in: needle per question (not per dataset)

Each dot is one question; x = the personal context that question actually needs (needle, log tokens; 1 image ≈ 512). Computed from raw per-question evidence: camroll-v2 anchor_images, ATM-Bench evidence_ids, DIS-Bench answer_photo_ids, camroll-v1 evidence; camroll-demo = our 25 designed queries (estimated). Each row is a density curve (where the mass of questions sits). On the baseline, each bubble = a distinct needle value, sized by how many questions share it; hover a bubble to see those questions in full (up to 20 listed for very large bubbles). All questions included (no subsampling).
